name: @thgilciffart/pi-websearch
description: Web search tool for the pi coding agent — one web_search tool, 10 providers (Tavily, Brave, Serper, Exa, Perplexity, You.com, Parallel, Linkup, SearXNG, DuckDuckGo) with automatic provider fallback. Calls search APIs directly, so a search costs the API pr
